query:
-- Extend lms_instructors with display fields
ALTER TABLE lms_instructors
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS title VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS social_links TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

-- Analytics permissions per instructor (admin-controlled)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS instructor_analytics_permissions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id INT NOT NULL,
  instructor_id INT NOT NULL,
  can_see_revenue BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  can_see_student_names BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  can_see_enrollment_count BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  can_see_completion_rate BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  can_see_quiz_scores BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  can_see_lesson_progress BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  can_see_revenue_breakdown BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  can_see_student_emails BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_org_instructor (org_id, instructor_id)
);
